preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 200000 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit())
preconditions.description: The first line contains two integers n and m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 2·10^5) representing the length of the string and the number of operations, respectively.
The second line is a string of length n, consisting of small and large English letters and digits.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 3 and line.split()[0].isdigit() and line.split()[1].isdigit() and len(line.split()[2]) == 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:])
preconditions.description: Each of the next m lines contains two integers l and r (1 ≤ l ≤ r) and a character c (small/large English letter or digit), where r does not exceed the current length of the string before the operation.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:])
preconditions.description: For each operation, l and r satisfy 1 ≤ l ≤ r.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join([s[i-1] for i in range(1, len(s)+1) if not any(l <= i <= r and s[i-1] == c for l, r, c in operations)])
postconditions.description: The output string is obtained by removing all characters c in the range [l, r] (inclusive) for each operation (l, r, c) in sequence, preserving the original order of remaining characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '' or all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output string consists only of small/large English letters and digits, or is empty.
